data.title: 陆八魔阿露 · 便利屋事务所的硬派恶党摆拍
data.description: 便利屋68事务所内，百叶窗斜切进冷硬的阳光。阿露一手按在深色实木办公桌上，另一手霸气地单持重型狙击步枪，酒红大衣无风自动。她嘴角扬起胜券在握的狂傲冷笑，极力向眼前的老师展现出顶级恶党首领的从容魅力。
data.action: posing confidently with sniper rifle on desk, smug smirk, dramatic stance
data.lighting: cool dramatic shadows slanting through window blinds
data.mood: flamboyant outlaw swagger and theatrical confidence
data.promptProse: Standing beside her office desk holding a heavy sniper rifle, Rikuhachima Aru smirks with exaggerated hardboiled confidence as light slants through the blinds.
data.animaCaption: Aru posing with smug confidence at her office desk holding her sniper rifle.
